title: Case 428

plan.situation: Two delivery attempts for the 190 kg crated oak table (AB-55102, SLP-BE-8830417) failed. The reason is that Hoogstraat Tower's dock portal, run by Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV, turned down the carrier's dock requests with 'NO_TENANT_SPONSOR'. It also shows the vehicle plate as unregistered and no certificate of insurance (COI) on file. Docking is only allowed Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 and there is a EUR 85.00 handling fee per slot. Scheldt Line holds the pallet at ANR-2 until 2026-01-20 and will then return it to the merchant. A third attempt costs EUR 62.50 and needs a confirmed time window from the consignee. The customer wants a firm date before the weekend or a refund.

facts.fact: Order AB-55102: oak table 280x100 cm, 190 kg, one crated pallet, value EUR 3,240.00. Terms are delivery to the door, unloading included.

Dock requests on 2026-01-12 and 2026-01-14 were REJECTED by the hoogstraat-tower dock portal with NO_TENANT_SPONSOR. Plate 1-LKW-482 is not registered, no COI is on file, the allowed window is Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 and the handling fee is EUR 85.00 per slot.
The dock portal is operated by Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV for the building.
Both attempts (2026-01-13 13:48 and 2026-01-15 11:01) failed with ACCESS_DENIED_DELIVERY_POINT.

The booth told the driver nothing was booked and he could not go to the lower yard. The table cannot go through the lobby or fit the passenger lift. The driver will not make a third attempt without a time slot.
The front desk told the customer that freight has to be on the system. She has no booking number or building document and has never had a large delivery before.
A third attempt costs EUR 62.50 and needs a confirmed time window from the consignee. The pallet is held at ANR-2 until 2026-01-20, then returned to the merchant at the merchant's cost.
The merchant dispatched on 2026-01-09 with a signed pallet handover and says it cannot act while the carrier has the goods.
The customer needs the table for 28 January and asks for a firm date before the weekend or a refund.
The possible extra charges (third attempt plus one dock slot) would add up to EUR 147.50. Nobody has decided who pays them.

conflicts: The customer says she was at her desk and nobody rang her (event 002). The carrier recorded 'access denied at delivery point'. The dock log (event 006) explains this as a building-portal rejection for lack of a tenant sponsor, not a refusal by the customer. Neither side is being blamed. The facts are given to the customer and the carrier so the booking can be fixed.
missing_information: Whether the customer, as a tenant, can sponsor a dock booking through Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV, and for which date(s) in the Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 window
Whether Scheldt Line can register plate 1-LKW-482 (or another tail-lift vehicle) and provide a COI to the building portal, and which morning dates it can attend before 2026-01-20
Who pays the EUR 62.50 third attempt and the EUR 85.00 dock handling fee (not decided; merchant terms include delivery to the door)
Whether the merchant would authorise a refund or extend the hold if delivery cannot be arranged (merchant decision; not requested yet)
risk_flags: Deadline: the pallet goes back to the merchant after 2026-01-20. Only a few Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 windows are left.
Money: EUR 62.50 attempt fee and EUR 85.00 slot fee. No allocation or waiver is committed or implied.
Refund demand: this is the merchant's decision. Nothing is promised.
Physical handling: 190 kg crate. Nobody is asked to carry it through the lobby or lift.

authority_map.controls: Tenant sponsorship of the dock booking with building management; confirming the time window the carrier needs
Dock access, slot approval, vehicle and COI registration, the EUR 85.00 handling fee
Third attempt booking, vehicle and COI submission, the EUR 62.50 fee, hold until 2026-01-20
Refund, cancellation, any extension or cost decision on return; delivery terms

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk made no earlier promise to the customer (event 005 was a fact-finding call). Since then, the dock log (event 006) shows the tenant-sponsor requirement, and customer care (event 007) gave the fee, the window requirement and the hold deadline of 2026-01-20.

plan.decision_summary: Ask the customer to get a dock booking sponsored as a tenant through Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV for a Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 slot before the 2026-01-20 hold ends. At the same time, ask Scheldt Line which morning dates it can attend and whether it can register its vehicle and COI with the building portal.
plan.rationale: Delivery is blocked by the building's dock rule. It requires a tenant sponsor, and only the customer can provide that. Without a sponsored slot, the carrier will not attempt again and no firm date is possible. The carrier's vehicle and COI registration is its own job and can run alongside, so the slot works once it is booked. A refund is the merchant's decision and is not needed while delivery is still possible within the hold.

actions.subject: Table AB-55102 (tracking SLP-BE-8830417): what is needed for delivery
actions.purpose: Get the tenant-sponsored dock booking that only the customer can arrange
actions.body:
Dear Ms Desmedt,

Thank you for your patience. We have now found out why both deliveries failed. Your table was not refused by you. The loading dock at Hoogstraat Tower is managed by Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV. Their dock booking system turned down the carrier's requests on 12 and 14 January because a tenant had not sponsored the booking. The table (190 kg, crated) cannot be taken through the front lobby or the passenger lift, so it has to come in through the dock.

What we need from you:
1. Please ask your building management or front desk (Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV) to approve, as a tenant, a dock booking for Scheldt Line Parcel, tracking SLP-BE-8830417. The building only allows deliveries Monday to Friday between 06:00 and 09:00.
2. Please send us the date and time they confirm, any booking reference they give you, and the name of the person at the building who approved it.

The carrier is holding your table at its depot until 20 January 2026, so please send this as soon as you can. The building's system shows a handling fee of EUR 85.00 per slot, and the carrier charges EUR 62.50 for a third attempt. Who pays these has not been decided yet, so please do not pay anything until we come back to you on it.

We cannot give you a firm delivery date until the building has confirmed a slot and the carrier has accepted it. We will confirm a date as soon as both are in place. We have also noted your refund request. Refunds are decided by Atelier Brum Furniture, and we will raise it with them if delivery cannot be arranged in time.

Kind regards,
Joost Verhaar
Kadewerk Delivery Desk

actions.to_role: Carrier customer care / dispatch, depot ANR-2
actions.subject: SLP-BE-8830417: dates you can attend and building portal registration before the 2026-01-20 hold ends
actions.purpose: Make sure the carrier can attend once the customer books the slot
actions.body:
Hello,

Regarding SLP-BE-8830417 (one pallet, 190 kg, held at ANR-2 until 2026-01-20): your dock log shows Hoogstraat Tower's portal (Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV) rejected the requests with NO_TENANT_SPONSOR. It also showed plate 1-LKW-482 as unregistered and no COI on file. The consignee is being asked to get a tenant-sponsored dock booking in the building's Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 window.

Please tell us by end of day 2026-01-16 CET:
1. Which morning dates between 06:00 and 09:00 you can attend with a tail-lift vehicle before 2026-01-20.
2. Whether you will register the vehicle plate and submit a COI to the building's dock portal, so that a sponsored slot is not rejected for those reasons.
3. Whether the hold at ANR-2 can be extended if the building's first available slot is after 2026-01-20.

This is a request for options, not a booking and not agreement to the EUR 62.50 third-attempt fee. Who pays will be confirmed separately.

Kind regards,
Joost Verhaar
Kadewerk Delivery Desk

actions.purpose: Reminder timer for the customer's dock booking and the carrier's options before the hold ends
actions.body: Check whether Marit Desmedt has sent a building-confirmed dock slot and whether Scheldt Line has replied with dates and registration status. If either is silent, send a reminder. If no slot by Monday 2026-01-19 morning, raise with Atelier Brum Furniture (merchant_authorisation) whether the hold should be extended, the order cancelled or refunded, and who pays the fees.

not_doing: Not giving a firm delivery date: neither the building nor the carrier has confirmed a slot.
Not promising or starting a refund: that is the merchant's decision and delivery is still possible within the hold.
Not agreeing to, waiving or assigning the EUR 62.50 or EUR 85.00 charges: nobody has decided who pays.
Not contacting Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV directly: the building needs a tenant to sponsor the booking, and that has to come from the customer.
Not asking anyone to carry the 190 kg crate through the lobby or lift.
Not blaming the customer, the driver or the building.
plan.follow_up: On 2026-01-16 12:00 CET, check for the customer's building-confirmed slot and the carrier's dates and registration reply. Once both are in, ask Scheldt Line to book the third attempt with a booking reference, and raise who pays the fees with the merchant. If there is no slot by 2026-01-19 morning, take the hold extension, refund or cancellation decision to Atelier Brum Furniture before the hold ends on 2026-01-20.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask the customer to get a dock booking sponsored as a tenant through Vastbeheer Hoogstraat NV for a Mon-Fri 06:00-09:00 slot before the 2026-01-20 hold ends. At the same time, ask Scheldt Line which morning dates it can attend and whether it can register its vehicle and COI with the building portal.

issues.problem: The customer is told not to pay anything until the desk comes back to her. If Vastbeheer wants the EUR 85.00 slot fee paid when the booking is made, this could hold up the only slots left before the 2026-01-20 hold ends (Fri 16, Mon 19).
issues.fix: Change the line to: if the building asks for the fee before it will confirm a slot, tell us straight away so it can be settled quickly. Do not tell her flatly not to pay.

issues.problem: The timing is tight. The carrier has until the end of 16 Jan to reply, and the merchant is only contacted on the morning of 19 Jan, the day before the pallet goes back at the merchant's cost. The customer also wants a firm date before the weekend.
issues.fix: Think about telling Atelier Brum Furniture now (an information note only, nothing decided) about the 2026-01-20 return deadline and the customer's refund demand. That way a merchant decision isn't squeezed into the last day.

issues.problem: case_parameters says evidence_conflict is false, but the plan lists a conflict (the customer's account against the 'access denied' code). There's also no clear need to ask the customer for the name of the person at the building who approved the slot. The booking reference and confirmed time are enough.
issues.fix: Make the conflict flag consistent and drop the request for the approver's name, or make it optional.

review.summary: I'm approving this plan. Both messages ask the right people for the next step: the customer is the only one who can sponsor the dock booking as a tenant, and the carrier handles its own vehicle registration, insurance certificate (COI) and the dates it can attend. Every figure and deadline comes from the record, and nothing is promised: no date, no refund, no decision on who pays the fees. The issues I found are minor: the "don't pay anything" wording, the tight timing for the merchant, and some internal inconsistencies.
